for: the `learn` section of the catalogue document (intake-run-or-learn-spec 2); matched on `kind`, never on id, label or wording

rules.kinds: the three runs on this commit give the same set of kinds (labels may differ)
rules.labels: at most 6 words, no path or file name
rules.options: 1 to 4; every anchor is a path (or directory) in the snapshot; no option anchored only under docs/
rules.cannot: matched on kind; thing and why are the model's own words

note: a data-publishing tool with a pytest suite: no scientific algorithm. `deploy` (Dockerfile, publish workflow, datasette/publish/) is offered too but is not required
